mapper.insert: insert into `user` (username, password, nickname, real_name, phone, email, avatar, gender, age, address, description, role, status, create_time) values (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{address}, #{description}, #{role}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select:
select * from `user`
and (username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and role = #{role}
order by create_time desc
